attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "DefaultPermissionService now builds the permission dictionary with a case-insensitive comparer, which changes how permission names collide across all modules and could silently drop or overwrite permissions that previously coexisted differing only by case, affecting core authorization behavior for every site built on Orchard Core."}
